title: 第892章 哪有胆子
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

灵兽们全部离去之后，韩榆便看向千秋子与忘忧散人。

“老祖，前辈……南域能有眼下局面，实属不易，还请两位暂歇几日清净日子，留在万春谷一段时日。”

“待到威胁渐去，再回去歇息。”

千秋子点头：“好，你既然安排周详，我们听你的便是。”

忘忧散人呵呵一笑：“应该这么说，我们又何时不听你这小滑头的？”

韩榆便又笑着欠身：“如此，我就多谢老祖与祖奶奶了！”

此言一出，大殿内众人皆是一怔，有人想笑而不敢笑。

有人偷偷用眼神打量忘忧散人，生怕她挂不住脸面，勃然大怒。

千秋子面色微红。

忘忧散人也红了脸，瞪了韩榆一眼：众目睽睽，这小滑头真敢胡言乱语！

但又不好伤了千秋子的脸面，之后口中含混着“嗯”了一声，故作不在意似的。

见此一幕，众人哪还有不知道的？

这分明是关系已定。

微清云笑着欠身道：“祖奶奶，您可有什么忌讳？我帮您安置一下房间去。”

温长老也起身道：“正该如此！”

两人上前，簇拥着忘忧散人往别处安排房间去了。

等到她们刚走，戚掌门、韩榆、吕长老、鲁恽、白十七等人一起向千秋子道贺。

“恭喜老祖，贺喜老祖！”

千秋子一身青衣，脸上带笑且红润：“这，喜从何来？”

戚掌门道：“老祖终于与祖奶奶成就佳缘，相伴相知，如此喜事，正该恭喜！”

千秋子笑着抬手：“行了，行了，你们知道便可。”

“忘忧面子薄，你们可不要再三提及，让她难堪。”

众人心道：我们哪有这个胆子？

“我等万万不敢对祖奶奶无礼。”戚掌门连忙说道。

韩榆则是向千秋子询问：“之前说笑也就罢了——如今喜事已定，如何称呼忘忧前辈？老祖，祖奶奶这个称呼，前辈是否满意？”

“若要不满，我们还是定一个其他的。”

千秋子老祖想了想，道：“她若不满意，只怕也不会容许你们称呼这几声……想来应该是满意的。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

After all the spirit beasts left, Han Yu looked at Qian Qiuzi and Wangyou Sanren.

"Ancestor, senior... It is not easy for the Southern Territory to be in the current situation. I would also like to ask you two to take a break for a few days and stay in Wanchun Valley for a while."

"Wait until the threat subsides, then go back and rest."

Qian Qiuzi nodded: "Okay, since you have made careful arrangements, we will listen to you."

Wangyou Sanren chuckled: "I should say that, when did we not listen to you little naughty guy?"

Han Yu then smiled and leaned forward: "In this case, I would like to thank my ancestor and grandma!"

As soon as these words came out, everyone in the hall was startled. Some people wanted to laugh but did not dare to laugh.

Someone secretly looked at Wangyou Sanren with their eyes, fearing that she would lose face and get angry.

Qianqiuzi's face turned red.

Wangyou Sanren also blushed and glared at Han Yu: In full view of everyone, this little naughty guy really dares to talk nonsense!

But he didn't want to hurt Qianqiuzi's face, so he mumbled "um" in his mouth, pretending not to care.

Seeing this scene, how can everyone not know?

This is clearly an established relationship.

Wei Qingyun smiled and leaned forward: "Grandma, do you have any taboos? I will help you arrange the room."

Elder Wen also stood up and said, "That's exactly what it should be!"

The two of them stepped forward, surrounded Wangyou Sanren, and went to arrange rooms elsewhere.

As soon as they left, Head Qi, Han Yu, Elder Lu, Lu Yun, Bai Qiqi and others congratulated Qian Qiuzi.

"Congratulations, ancestor, congratulations, ancestor!"

Qianqiuzi was dressed in green clothes, with a smile on her face and a rosy face: "Where does this joy come from?"

Headmaster Qi said: "My ancestor finally has a good relationship with my grandmother, and they know each other well. Congratulations are right for such a happy event!"

Qianqiuzi smiled and raised his hand: "Okay, okay, you just know."

"Wangyou has a bad reputation. Don't embarrass her by mentioning it again and again."

Everyone thought: How can we have the courage?

"We would never dare to be rude to grandma." Head Qi said quickly.

Han Yu asked Qian Qiuzi: "It was just a joke before - now that the happy event has been decided, how should we call senior Wangyou? Are you satisfied with the title of ancestor, grandma?"

"If you're not satisfied, we'll order another one."

Ancestor Qianqiuzi thought for a while and said: "If she is not satisfied, I'm afraid she won't allow you to call me these names... I think she should be satisfied."
